subject: Sprint launch uplift request — provisional overage and cap proposal
messages:
From: Mike Harris <mike@finovate.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: quota uplift needed for Sept sprint launch

Dylan —

We have a hard launch window for our new payments flow next Tuesday (09/14) and traffic estimates just came in much higher than expected. We need a short-term uplift to avoid throttling during the first 72 hours. Rough numbers: baseline 1.2M tokens/day, expected peak 5.6M tokens/day for ~72 hours.

Can Redwood provisionally bump our quota and/or rate limits for that window? We are happy to pay overages but need a predictable cap and invoice path — the team needs to know cost exposure before engineering locks in traffic. I attached the spike forecast and a one-pager with expected patterns (finovate_surge_request_09082026.pdf).

Two immediate asks:
- Can you increase the concurrent rate limit for the api-key to support ~3x burst per second?
- Can we agree a provisional overage rate and a maximum daily spend cap so we can move forward?

Appreciate fast help on this, we can be on a call in 30 if helpful.

Thanks,
Mike Harris
VP Product, Finovate

[attachment: finovate_surge_request_09082026.pdf]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Harris <mike@finovate.ai>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-08T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: quota uplift needed for Sept sprint launch

Mike —

Thanks for the heads up and for the attachment. We can support a provisional uplift for the 72-hour launch window with a couple guardrails so your team has predictability. High level proposal (attached as provisional_surge_terms_0909.pdf):

- Uplift: increase quota from 1.2M -> 6M tokens/day (5x) for 72 hours starting at an agreed time.
- Rate limits: temporary concurrent RPS cap increased to support the burst profile; we will stage the change at a scheduled minute to avoid connection storms.
- Overage pricing: instead of standard pay-as-you-go, offer a provisional overage rate at 40% discount to your current PAYG price for tokens consumed above the uplift during the 72-hour window.
- Spend cap: we can cap the daily uplift exposure at $18,000/day (total cap for 72h = $54,000). If you prefer a higher cap we can raise it subject to quick approval.
- True-up & invoice: we will tally actual usage, apply the provisional discount, and issue a single true-up invoice within 7 business days post-window.

Next steps I suggest: you confirm the requested start time (I can align infra), sign the DocuSign amendment, and we schedule a 15m runbook call with your ops + our SREs.

I attached the short terms doc for legal and billing. If you want a steeper discount we can consider trading a higher committed add-on or a brief case study/quote.

Can you confirm acceptance of the cap and the time window?

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Operational asks:

If we sign this, we'll need to ensure the uplift is tagged so it doesn't auto-apply to committed capacity calculations.

Thanks — I can jump on a quick sync.

—Dylan
